: Broadband revenue reached $536,465 in the quarter, up from $502,637, mainly due to additional internet service connection sales.
: Technology revenue increased to $1.03M from $750,173, reflecting delivery of additional IT projects.
: The business contributed $5.48M in quarterly revenue; it was acquired on December 15, 2025, so there was no comparable prior-year contribution.
